title: Nanoindentation Dataset: PMDCo (Simplified Input)
description: User-friendly form for a single nanoindentation indent — the digital twin of one measurement file. Enter the indent metadata and scalar results as a results array. The transform converts this to full OO-LD (MeasurementDatum + ScalarValueSpecification nodes).

dataset_name.title: Dataset Name
dataset_name.description: Human-readable name for this indent dataset.

dataset_id.title: Dataset ID
dataset_id.description: Optional IRI slug for the RDF node. Auto-derived from dataset_name if omitted.

indent_index.title: Indent Index
indent_index.description: Sequential number of this indentation within the session (1-based).

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: Date and time of this individual indentation (ISO 8601).

x_position.title: X Position (mm)
x_position.description: Stage X coordinate at time of indent.

y_position.title: Y Position (mm)
y_position.description: Stage Y coordinate at time of indent.

format.title: File Format
format.description: Instrument file format of the raw data.

analysis_warnings.title: Analysis Warnings
analysis_warnings.description: Warnings reported by instrument software for this indent.
examples: hc out of calibrated range [42 nm, 593 nm]

columns.title: Timeseries Column Specifications
columns.description: Semantic column specs from the parser — column name mapped to EMMO property IRI and QUDT unit IRI.

results.title: Indentation Results
results.description: Scalar results from the load-displacement curve analysis. Add one entry per quantity.

name.title: Property Name
name.description: Name of the measured or derived quantity.

examples.analysis_warnings: hc out of calibrated range [42 nm, 593 nm]
